findings.validator_behavior: tools/validate_wp_state_consistency_v1.py rejects any pointer state that is neither the single contract active_state nor a terminal state before claim-file binding
findings.impact: Current legitimate-looking active pointers using IN_PROGRESS or CLAIMED cannot pass the declared v1 consistency validator. Aggregate projection repair alone cannot make these pointer generations validator-consistent.

findings.observed: workpackages/STATE_CONSISTENCY_CONTRACT.md requires legacy_claim_ref on every active pointer, while WORKPACKAGE_STATE_CONSISTENCY_CONTRACT_V1.json and validate_wp_state_consistency_v1.py bind claim identity by workpackage_id+generation+claim_id and do not require legacy_claim_ref
findings.impact: Human and executable definitions disagree about the required pointer ABI; a green machine validator would not prove the Markdown contract as written.

findings.observed: On branch chatgpt/trigger4-wp002-g5-aggregate-projection-repair-20260829, workpackages/STATE.json still had WP300/WP301/WP302/WP303/WP304 as NOT_STARTED and omitted WP206 at the inspected source identity.
findings.impact: No failure is inferred merely from this in-progress snapshot; it is preserved so terminal reconciliation can prove the stale set was actually closed.

counterhypothesis: IN_PROGRESS and CLAIMED may be intentionally admitted compatibility aliases for ACTIVE and legacy_claim_ref may have been deliberately retired; if so, the executable contract, Markdown contract and validator have not yet been successor-versioned to encode that policy.
cheapest_discriminator: Before terminalizing WP002 G5, run validate_wp_state_consistency_v1.py against at least WP207, WP302, WP303 and one accepted terminal pointer at the exact candidate head. Require either canonical normalization to ACTIVE or an explicit successor contract/validator version that admits the intended nonterminal aliases, plus one synchronized human/machine contract definition.
recommended_owner_action: Fold this contradiction into the existing WP002 G5 mutation lane; do not open a competing projection-repair authority.
